tasks.short: Determine salvage value of a total-loss vehicle

steps.what: Determine salvage value from vehicle condition, comparable evidence and disposal constraints

tasks.design: Retain salvage valuation with the appraiser using the existing claims workspace {OTHER} and source evidence in {DOCS}. Photo damage assessment does not establish the recoverable salvage value or replace market judgment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Salvage value depends on condition, market evidence and the circumstances of disposal.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing claims records and comparable evidence support a documented valuation.
tasks.still_hard: Thin comparables, hidden damage and differences in disposal terms.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser judges comparability and explains a defensible range.

reach.learn: Distinguish comparable evidence from an unsupported point estimate

evidence.claim: Tractable provides vehicle damage assessment from photos; that does not establish automated salvage valuation or a saving in this task.

assumptions: This baseline is valuation rather than claim intake, repair estimating or a separate report-formatting operation.
The appraiser gathers and checks condition and comparable evidence within s1 with all time retained; no free structured salvage grade or market-clearing price is assumed.
OTHER means existing claims workspace; native evidence views precede a new valuation service.
No new model or data service is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Available salvage evidence and disposal terms
research_questions: How much time is spent repeatedly assembling comparable evidence rather than judging value?

already_counted.description: Evidence gathering, comparability assessment and valuation reasoning

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100; gross and net saving zero. A photo damage capability does not measure salvage valuation labour.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange a second appraisal to resolve repair-cost disagreement

steps.what: Clarify repair cost disagreement and select an appropriate second appraiser
Arrange the damage appraisal and confirm access and evidence with the shop

tasks.design: Keep disagreement clarification, appraiser selection and coordination with the appraiser using {EMAIL}, {CALENDAR} and the claims workspace {OTHER}. A standard referral template can support the current process without an invented independent paperwork stage.
tasks.previous_blocker: The parties must agree the disputed points and practical access for another assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing communication and calendar tools support coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining trust and finding an appropriate second opinion with workable access.
tasks.human_edge: The appraiser understands the disagreement and communicates a fair referral scope.

reach.learn: Define the disputed question clearly before referral

evidence.claim: Manual second-appraisal coordination is an E1 proposal; the digest establishes no measured replacement of repair-cost disagreement handling.

assumptions: The baseline is arranging the second appraisal rather than conducting it or deciding settlement.
The focal appraiser obtains the shop explanation and referral scope in s1 and confirms access in s2; all capture and coordination time remains counted.
Availability and access are confirmed through existing discussions, with no new structured reporting contract or automatic external booking.
OTHER means claims workspace; existing templates and calendars suffice, so there is no incremental service upkeep or new second-appraiser work beyond the baseline referral.
research_questions: Does preparing referral evidence consume measurable time distinct from resolving scope and arranging access?

already_counted.description: Clarify dispute, select appraiser and arrange access and referral

incremental.description: No additional referral service or transfer of existing work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. No repeatable referral paperwork component is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Defensible vehicle valuation and fair dispute coordination
reach: Learn comparable-evidence discipline from property appraisers
Coordinate clear referral questions with claims adjusters
skills_to_grow: Clear referral scope and evidence sharing
role.ambitious_version: An appraiser who makes valuation reasoning transparent and handles second opinions with clear scope
